label: Тоже
description: The additive тоже ('also/too'): same predicate applied to a new subject, including тоже не ('neither'), with a note vs также and то же.

missions.phrase: Я тоже хочу пойти с вами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same wish, new subject. The predicate хочу is shared with someone mentioned earlier, and тоже marks я as another person who wants the same thing. This is the subject-additive use.

missions.phrase: Он тоже здесь, рядом со мной.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same place, new subject. Здесь is the shared predicate, and тоже adds он to those who are present. Note that тоже is one word, distinct from то же ('the same').
Strategic focus: Same action, new subject. Идём repeats an action already established for others, and тоже joins мы to the goers. The verb идём carries the ё.

missions.phrase: Они тоже хорошо знают этот город.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same knowledge, new subject. Знают is the shared predicate, and тоже extends it to они. This is a plural subject-additive line.
Strategic focus: Same state, new subject. Устал describes a condition already noted for someone, and тоже applies it to ты as well. The predicate here is an adjectival state form.

missions.phrase: Я тоже не знаю, что делать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared negation. Не знаю is negated, and тоже не together mean 'neither', so я joins those who do not know. Тоже precedes the negated verb.

missions.phrase: Он тоже не пришёл на встречу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared absence. Не пришёл is negated, and тоже не gives the sense 'neither', so он also failed to come. The verb пришёл carries the ё.
Strategic focus: Same role, new subject. Студентка is a zero-copula nominal predicate, and тоже adds она to that group. There is no verb in this nominal predicate.
Strategic focus: Same judgment, new subject. Правы is the shared predicate, and тоже extends it to вы. Compare также, which adds 'in addition' rather than repeating a predicate.

missions.phrase: Наш кот тоже спит на диване.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same action, new subject. Спит repeats an action already established, and тоже joins кот to the sleepers. Remember that тоже is one word, not то же ('the same').
